All hosts, orgs, and paths are anonymized or already-public SaaS domains — this repo is public. The 31 `intent-context-*` rows at the end come from Sean Perkins' https://github.com/STRML/omp-classifier/pull/83: ordinary task instructions (smoke checks, approved test runs, review feedback) that must not read as reviewer injection, plus 8 held-out paraphrases.
